attempts.sql: SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols s JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/' AND f.is_test = False AND s.is_public = True AND s.name NOT LIKE '%__%' ESCAPE '/' AND NOT (s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname LIKE '%__%__') AND NOT (s.kind = 'class' AND s.name LIKE '_%') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query counts public symbols from the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package by joining symbols to files on file_id, excluding test files and filtering for is_public = True. It then applies the name-based exclusion rules: names containing __ are excluded, methods with __ in qualname are excluded, and classes starting with _ are excluded, grouping the remaining records by kind and counting per kind.
sql: SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols s JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/' AND f.is_test = False AND s.is_public = True AND s.name NOT LIKE '%__%' ESCAPE '/' AND NOT (s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname LIKE '%__%__') AND NOT (s.kind = 'class' AND s.name LIKE '_%') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind
